name: TREEGONE
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A polysynth in the manner of the Sequential Trigon-6: three oscillators per voice (triangle, sawtooth, reverse sawtooth on osc 3, pulse, all at once), sync, osc 3 LO, noise, FDBK <> DRIVE, three filters as on the Pro 3 (LP1 4-pole OTA, LP2 4/2-pole ladder, SVF 2-pole OTA), two ADSR, LFO to audio rate, poly mod, aftertouch, vintage, distortion, two effects with reverbs, glide, unison with chord memory, arp and poly sequencer, 6 or 12 voices. ECO and HIGH quality. Panel-style touch pages.
